provenance.artifact_first_seen_commit_message: V229 FlyWire morphology recovery and V230 synapse coordinates

codex_documented_fafb_connection_thresho.interpretation: V230 observed minimum of 5 rows per pre/post pair is consistent with the documented FAFB connectivity threshold, but this does not prove the historical V230 extraction used that rule.

exact_coordinate_probe.reason: Programmatic FlyWire/CAVE access requires an access token in the execution environment.

observations: All 75 observed pre/post pairs contain at least 5 coordinate rows.
The four V229 target roots occur as postsynaptic roots, but 34 additional postsynaptic roots are also present.
inference_not_proof: The minimum of 5 rows per observed pair is consistent with a >=5-synapse selection rule, but the repository does not prove that this was the extraction rule.
The single x/y/z triplet per row is consistent with synapse coordinates, but the repository does not prove whether these are pre- or post-synaptic coordinates or another coordinate representation.
